expectation: Nuclear FOXP3 in Tregs: a CD4+ subset, usually a few percent of lymphocytes. Expect scattered single nuclei, enriched in lymphoid aggregates and immune infiltrates, sitting on a subset of CD4+ cells. Not in epithelium or stroma.
observed: A: haze following the tissue outline, tiling, background squares and bright speckles scattered on and off the tissue. B/C: diffuse haze with a few large blobs and a streak. D: a featureless bright haze, no nuclei. E1: sub-cellular grain. E3: CD4 cells stay magenta with almost no white overlap.
why: No distinct population of FOXP3+ nuclei at any scale, and none on CD4 cells. The signal is haze, tiling and debris speckle.
notes: FOXP3 shows tissue-wide haze, tile artefacts and scattered bright debris. The brightest spot (D) is haze with no nuclei. In the dense CD4 field, FOXP3 is fine grain and almost no CD4 cells are co-stained.
